name: Madogiwa!
source:
Main character helps a stray dog on the way home from school, and a bald fat angel wearing only pants appears in front of him. Protagonist takes it as a joke and agrees to borrow power, but what he gets is impossible to imagine abilities like flying and moving objects remotely. With that he can cause a lot of trouble in the city...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在放学回家途中救助了一条流浪狗，面前随即冒出一个只穿一条内裤的秃头胖天使。主人公只当是个玩笑，随口答应借用对方的力量，谁知竟获得了飞行、隔空移物等匪夷所思的超能力。仗着这身本事，他大可在城里掀起一阵鸡飞狗跳……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
